cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put my form down for tomorrow. You can give me one extra day as a trial.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody has had an extension. Why should I start with you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're welcome to start with me. Keep the form beside today's batch; we'll see whether an extra night damages it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One day. No more. I'm marking it as an exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Date that note and keep it with the completed form. Next time, bring this trial out before you tell anyone we've never allowed an extra day. We'll have an actual result to discuss.

reason: Treat B why-me question as permission to inaugurate a trial under A direction; use B exception marking as the preserved evidence for later precedent rather than denying the one-day limit.
